patterns: How do I return an item?
responses: We offer a hassle-free 30-day return policy for unused items in original packaging. Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days upon receiving the return.
Our flagship stores are open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and Sundays from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Our online platform operates 24/7!
Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days (Free on orders over $50). Express shipping takes 1-2 business days for a flat rate of $9.99.

patterns: What payment methods do you accept?
Can I pay with credit card?
responses: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Cash on Delivery (select zip codes).

patterns: How do I join VIP club?
responses: Our Loyalty Rewards program lets you earn 1 point for every $1 spent! Redeem 100 points for $5 off your next purchase. Facial recognition in-store auto-checks your VIP status!
Use code 'WELCOME10' at checkout for 10% off your first order! Check our 'Deals' page daily for clearance sales up to 50% off.
You can search all our store locations and get directions using our interactive Store Finder on our website or app!

patterns: Does this product have a warranty?
responses: All electronics and appliances come with a standard 1-year manufacturer warranty. Extended 2-year protection plans are available at checkout.

patterns: How to check gift card balance
responses: Yes! Digital gift cards are available in amounts from $10 to $500. You can check your gift card balance on our checkout page.
Orders can be canceled within 1 hour of placing them directly from your account page before they enter processing.
